early_html:
Phase three pre-release

Phases one and two sold out in 5 and 7 days. Phase three is next, at the same prices. Choose yours before it launches.
awards: Smaller Apartment Scheme of the Year
faq: Book a 3D virtual tour and choose your apartment with us. £3,000 then takes it off the market: £2,500 is your reservation deposit and counts towards your 20% deposit, and £500 is BRIK Studios' admin fee.
What do I pay, and when?

£3,000 to reserve. The rest of your 20% deposit within 28 days, when contracts are exchanged. The balance on completion, expected September 2027, usually with a 75% buy-to-let mortgage plus a 5% top-up.
Can I buy with a mortgage?
Yes. Most buyers use a 75% buy-to-let mortgage, arranged in the months before completion. We can introduce you to our mortgage broker.
What are the lease and ground rent?
A 999-year lease with nil ground rent, and a 10-year build warranty.
The service charge is £2.24 per sq ft per year, about £81 a month for the example one bed. If we manage the letting, that's 10% of the rent. Both are already in every number in this report.
Who finds the tenant and manages it?
We do: tenant find, referencing, rent collection and day-to-day management, for 10% of the rent. You don't need to live nearby, and our office is on site.
Can I see it before I buy?
The Print House is under construction, so we take you round our 3D model of the finished building on a video call. You're welcome to visit the site with us too: it will be BRIK Studios' headquarters.
September 2027. We'll keep you updated as the build progresses, and you'll get notice to complete well ahead of the date.

urgency.h: Phases one and two sold out in 5 and 7 days.
urgency.p: Phase three is next, at the same prices: there have been no price increases between phases. When it launches it's first come, first served, so choose yours on a 3D tour before it goes live.

p: It's broken down into easy steps, in the order you need them. There's a lot of information here, and anyone considering a property investment in the North West of England should take the time to read it. It boils down decades of UK property investment experience, several years of buying, selling and investing in Stockport ourselves, and many hours of research by our team and founders, pulling together market reports, government documents and property data.
So take your time. By the end you'll fully understand not only The Print House, but the wider case for Stockport, and why we're convinced it's the best place in the UK to invest.
